narration.text: This is the Fabric Synagogue, completed in 1899 to designs by Lipót Baumhorn. Its facade combines Moorish-inspired arches and decoration with historic European forms, a typical Eclectic mix that was popular at the end of the nineteenth century.
narration.history: Baumhorn designed many synagogues across the former Kingdom of Hungary, and this one served the Jewish community of the Fabric district.
narration.why_it_matters: It is a major landmark of Fabric and of Timișoara's multicultural heritage.
